p23.removed: Four P23-to-P22 screw counterbores, the probe's two captive-nut slots
p23.added: Two rear ears with screw holes at (+/-15.8, -19.5); spigot sockets at the probe holes

carriage_internal.checked: Every changed part, the raised Beacon and the new fasteners against each other and the whole carriage (core, P20-P24, cable, EBB42, all accessory fasteners).

cartographer.note: Checked in place of the Beacon; the Beacon and its cable are not fitted with it.

beacon_keepouts.note: Only metal is excluded. P01 is printed (is_metal false in the v26 metadata) and reached 121.7 mm3 into the top zone at the released height.

frame_source.note: Nominal frame, panels and door from 01_Voron24_350_Frame_and_Enclosure as world bounding boxes (conservative for the extrusion profiles). No Z drives, bed supports or bed wiring are modeled.

hardware.probe: 2x M3x6 low-profile SHCS (head 5.5 x 1.5) through the probe board and P23 into 2x M3 x 3 mm heat-set inserts (OD 4.5) in P22. Replaces the M3 screws and captive nuts in P23.
hardware.p23_to_p22: 2x M3x4 ISO 7380 button-head screws on the rear ears into 2x M3 x 3 mm inserts in P22. Replaces 4x M3 screws whose heads sat between P23 and the probe board.

limitations: Rigid CAD and sampled straight paths. Insert pull-out, P23 creep under the probe clamp and the probe's electrical behaviour are not qualified.
The Beacon's 1.1 mm top-side block is the manufacturer model's component volume; it is treated as occupied.
The Bambu tip is restored to the datum from the reference's own cone; measure the real nozzle: its tip should be 38.75 mm below the two upper mounting-hole centres (Z-40.13).
The Cartographer is checked in place of the Beacon; its own cable route is not modelled.
